newsitem.title: RUSSIA: New Chechnya envoy meets rebel leaders.
newsitem.headline: New Chechnya envoy meets rebel leaders.

text.p: Russia's new peace envoy to Chechnya, Ivan Rybkin, met rebel leaders, including former chief-off-staff Aslan Maskhadov, on Sunday, Itar-Tass news agency said.

The meeting, Rybkin's first with the rebels since he took over from ousted Russian security chief Alexander Lebed, took place in the Ingushetia region neighbouring Chechnya, Tass said. It added that further details were not immediately available.
The rebels have expressed concern that Lebed's dismissal earlier this month might affect the peace deal he signed with them in August to end 21 months of fighting.

Some officials and politicians in Moscow have said they oppose the deal, arguing that it gives too much away to the rebels, who have treated it as a victory in their fight to split Chechnya from Moscow.
Rybkin said on arrival in Ingushetia that he wanted to discuss ways to consolidate peace in the region.
